supersedes.reason: Registry resolution and the selected browser-validation skill exposed compatibility constraints before implementation was accepted.

decisions: Starlette 1.3.1 recommends httpx2 for TestClient, so the initially frozen httpx 0.28.1 entry was replaced.
All Python commands continue to use the project .venv.
TypeScript 7.0.2 was rejected because the selected typescript-eslint release requires a TypeScript version below 6.1.
The Playwright test package and axe wrapper were removed; live browser validation uses the repository-external Playwright CLI workflow.
